newsitem.title: CROATIA: Ivana Trump may promote Croatian tourism.
newsitem.headline: Ivana Trump may promote Croatian tourism.

text.p: Ivana Trump, a businesswoman and former wife of American tycoon Donald Trump, met Croatian government officials on Monday to discuss promoting Croatian tourism, the state agency HINA reported.

Ivana Trump and current husband Richard Mazzuchielli, received by presidential chief of staff Hrvoje Sarinic, said Croatia had a "beautiful coast" and expressed interest in helping revive its tourism after the end of war in the region.
Sarinic announced Croatia would soon reach prewar tourist numbers and added that developing tourism with all the necessary infrastructure was among its goals.
